meaning: The number 74,600 is not a symbol in itself but appears as a concrete census figure in Numbers.
description: In Numbers (Numeri) chapters 1 and 2, 74,600 is given as the number of fighting men in the tribe of Judah during the first census in the wilderness. The tribe of Judah was the largest of the twelve tribes and was given a leading position in the camp and during the march. Thus, the number has historical and narrative significance tied to Judah's prominent role among the tribes of Israel, rather than an independent symbolic meaning in Jewish numerology.

footnotes.text: According to Numbers 2:3–9, the tribe of Judah camped east of the tabernacle, toward the sunrise, and broke camp first when the people moved on. This positioning underscores Judah's leadership role and points forward to the messianic line through Judah (Gen 49:10).
